name: Tristan da Cunha
subregion: Part of a British Overseas Territory
facts: Part of the British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

flag.description: A Blue Ensign with the island's coat of arms in the fly: a shield with four albatrosses around a central diamond, held by two rock lobsters, topped by a naval crown and a longboat, with the motto "Our faith is our strength".
flag.symbolism: The albatrosses and rock lobsters represent the island's wildlife and fishing, and the longboat its seafaring islanders.

hook: Tristan da Cunha's Blue Ensign is guarded by two upright red rock lobsters, the catch the island lives on.
trivia: Tristan rock lobster, shown holding the shield, is the island's main export.
With no airstrip and a voyage of about six days from Cape Town, Tristan is often called the most remote inhabited island in the world.
